invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.22.0 preserves the completed billing product, business-owner payment-provider connections, customer-facing hosted Pay Now, and Safaricom M-PESA Express STK Push. M-PESA retains C2B Paybill/Till reconciliation while connected businesses may additionally configure Paybill/Till type and an encrypted Lipa na M-PESA Online passkey. STK prompts accept only the payer phone from the browser: invoice identity, exact whole-KES balance, currency, shortcode and merchant credentials remain server-authoritative. STK callbacks use one-time hashed callback tokens and are re-verified through Daraja STK Query; callback and polling fallback converge on the same CheckoutRequestID idempotency identity and authoritative invoice/Accounting settlement core. The release gate includes Invoicing and STK regressions, provider connector contracts, quality locks, module migrations, responsive/app UI, ERP integration, TypeScript and production build.
